approach.eyebrow: CHAPTER I • THE OLD TIMBER ROAD
approach.title: A Wagon in the Trees
paragraphs: The road turns north beneath a canopy of pines. Somewhere beyond the bend, a horse whinnies once and falls silent.
A canvas-covered wagon stands crooked across the track. Its wheel is caught in a rut; two travelling chests lie abandoned nearby. A small fire burns where no traveller can be seen.
Pip spots a hurried footprint beside the road. Alden hears a bowstring creak from the trees. There may still be time to choose where everyone stands.

victory.title: The Road Falls Silent
paragraphs: The last goblin falls, and the forest grows quiet again. Smoke curls over the fire beside the wagon.
Beneath the overturned travel chest, the party finds a little coin. No useful weapons or armour are worth salvaging.
Beyond the trees, the old road continues towards the Azure Mines.

defeat.title: The Road Takes Its Toll
paragraphs: The goblins reclaim the clearing. The journey towards the Azure Mines ends at this broken wagon.
The party may try the approach again with a different deployment.

aftermath.title: Beyond the Wagon
paragraphs: The adventurers gather their bearings and follow the wagon tracks east.
The next stretch of road—and the first town—will be built as we connect combat to exploration.
